प्रशंसक, प्रशंसिन् a. Praising,
laudatory, eulogistic. --m. A panegyrist.

प्रशंसक, प्रशंसिन् a. Praising,
laudatory, eulogistic. --m. A panegyrist.

1 Praise, eulogy,
panegyric, applause; प्रशंसावचनं ‘a
complimentary or laudatory remark.’
--2
Description, reference to; as in
अप्रस्तुतप्रशंसा q. v.
--3 Glory, fame,
reputation.
--Comp.
--उपमा one of
the several kinds of उपमा
mentioned by Daṇḍin; ब्रह्मणोऽप्युद्भवः पद्मश्चंद्रः
शंभुशिरोधृतः । तौ तुल्यौ त्वन्मुखेनेति सा
प्रशंसोपमोच्यते ॥

प्रशंसित^1 p. p. Praised, extolled,
applauded.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,.

प्रशस्त p. p.
1 Praised, lauded,
commended, eulogised.
--2
Praiseworthy, commendable.
--3 Best,
excellent.
--4 Blossed, happy,
auspicious.
--Comp.
--अद्रिः N. of a
mountain.

प्रशस्तिः f.
1 Praise, eulogy,
laudation.
--2 Description;

.
--3 A
panegyric or small poem written in
praise of any one (e. g. a patron.).
--4 Excellence, eminence.
--5
Bonediction.
--6 Guidance, instruction,
rule for guidance; as in लेखप्रशस्तिः
‘a form of writing’.

superl. श्रेष्ठ or ज्येष्ठ) Praiseworthy,
commendable, excellent.

To become calm or
tranquil.
--2 To be soothed or
appeased.
--3 To stop, cease, terminate.
--4 To be allayed, be quenched or
extinguished; प्रशांतं पावकास्त्रं

.
--2 To allay,
extinguish, quench, put down;
त्वामासारप्रशमितवनोपप्लवं

.
--3
To remove, put an end to; तं (

.

compose; प्रशमयसि विवादं कल्पसे

--7
To cure, heal.

.
--4 Cessation, end, destruction;
Śi. 20. 73.

appeasement; Śi. 16. 51.

1 Tranquillity, calm,
composure.
--2 Quenching, extinction,
allaying.
--3 Cessation.

प्रशमन a. (नी f.)
1 Calming,

--2 Curing, healing.
--नं

tranquillizing, pacifying.
--2
Allaying, assuaging, soothing, mitigating;

.

Cessation, abatement.

1 Pacified, soothed,
composed, appeased, allayed.
--2
Extinguished, quenched.
--3 Atoned

1 Calmed,

--2 Calm, serene, quiet,
sedate, still; अहो

तत्सर्वमेकपद एव मम प्रशांतं

withdrawn.’

with प्र).

composed in mind, peaceful, calm.
--ऊर्ज a. weakened, enervated,
prostrated.
--काम a. content.

resting, ceased to work.

having all obstacles or calamities

tranquillity, composure, quiet, repose.
--2

Allaying, quenching, extinction.

.

; 9. 1.

governor.
--2 A director, adviser;

प्रशिष्टिः, प्रशिस् f. Ved. Command,
order.

प्रश्नः [प्रच्छ्-भावे नङ्]

question, query; an inquiry,
interrogation (अविज्ञातप्रवचनं प्रश्न इत्यभिधीयते);
अनामयप्रश्नपूर्वकं Ś. 5 ‘with an
inquiry about (your) well-being or
health’.
--2 A judicial inquiry or
investigation.
--3 A point at issue,
a subject of controversy,
controverted or disputed point;

उपस्थितः.
--4 A problem for solution
or calculation; अहं ते प्रश्नं दास्यामि

.
--5 Inquiry into the future.
--6 A short section of a work.
--7
Basket-work.
--Comp.
--उपनिषद् n.
N. of an Upaniṣad consisting of
six questions and six answers.
--दूतिः -ती f. a riddle, an enigma.
--विवाकः an arbitrator, umpire.

; सप्रश्रयं

1 To

.

[]
(प्रसंगेन, प्रसंगतः, प्रसंगात् are used
adverbially in the sense of
1 in
